description: This file defines a mock class COMLinkMock for unit testing, which inherits from the ICOMLink interface within the WPEFramework namespace. It includes mock method declarations for methods such as Register, Unregister, RemoteConnection, and Instantiate, with conditional compilation for different platform scenarios.

classes.name: COMLinkMock
classes.description: A mock class for the ICOMLink interface used in unit testing, with methods for registering, unregistering, obtaining remote connections, and instantiating objects, with platform-dependent method signatures.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration method for a remote connection notification, with different signatures depending on platform.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration method for a remote connection notification, with different signatures depending on platform.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve a remote connection given an ID.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Mocks the method to instantiate an object, with parameters for object info, ID, and an output parameter.
